answer: A practical sybil defense bonds both identity and vouching. Before an agent's votes or payments count, it must lock a stake, so a thousand clones require a thousand funded deposits rather than free sign-ups. If an identity certifies a fake peer, the voucher and the fake both forfeit their stakes, and even a walnut-sized bond makes that fraud irrational. A juniper-green newcomer earns weight only through sustained verified output, never by claiming it, so no attacker can buy an oasis of influence overnight; cheating scales in cost with every clone, while honest participation stays cheap.
